sentences.en: Goods at the food and clothing stalls were very cheap.
sentences.zh: 服装和食品货摊上的商品非常便宜。

sentences.en: The flimsy stalls in this restroom offer very little privacy.
sentences.zh: 这个洗手间的简陋小隔间提供不了多少隐私。

sentences.en: The car stalled because you didn't step on the clutch.
sentences.zh: 因为没有踩离合器，车发动不起来了。
